title: Seabbatical at WaterColor | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set along the tranquil shores of Western Lake in WaterColor’s coveted Phase 1 Park District, this stunning eight-bedroom beach cottage offers an exceptional blend of coastal charm and refined luxury. Designed to accommodate up to 18, the home features expansive living spaces, eight full bathrooms and a half bath, and multiple deep screened porches that frame breathtaking lake views. The open-concept main living area flows effortlessly from a chef’s kitchen with premium Viking appliances to inviting dining and lounge spaces, all opening onto a spacious screened porch ideal for outdoor dining, relaxing, and sunset views over the water. A serene primary suite on the main level includes a private sitting area and deck access, creating a peaceful lakeside retreat. Upstairs, beautifully appointed guest suites provide comfort and privacy, while additional living areas—including a third-floor media space and a private carriage house—offer flexibility for larger groups. Outdoors, a private pool and generous porches invite slow mornings and relaxed evenings surrounded by the natural beauty of the coastal dune lake. With a six-seater golf cart, six adult bikes, and close proximity to the Beach Club, trails, parks, and WaterColor’s renowned dining and shopping, this remarkable home captures the essence of elevated 30A living in one unforgettable setting.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
